azureLogAnalytics.query:
let requestInput = AppRequests
| extend Customer = tostring(Properties["Subscription Name"]),
         Model = tostring(Properties["Response-x-aigw-model"]),
         Tokens = todouble(Properties["Response-x-aigw-quota-consumed"])
| project TimeGenerated, Customer, Model, Direction = "Input", Tokens;
let metricOutput = AppMetrics
| where Name == "Completion Tokens"
| extend Customer = tostring(Properties.Customer),
         Model = tostring(Properties.Model),
         Tokens = todouble(Sum)
| project TimeGenerated, Customer, Model, Direction = "Output", Tokens;
union requestInput, metricOutput
| where isnotempty(Customer) and isnotempty(Model) and isnotnull(Tokens) and Tokens >= 0

| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| distinct Customer
| order by Customer asc

options.content: **Select your Subscription and Log Analytics workspace above.** Input uses AppRequests Properties['Response-x-aigw-quota-consumed'] only when your source custom rule defines it as input tokens. Output uses only AppMetrics **Completion Tokens**, summing **Sum** once, never multiplying by ItemCount. Prompt, total, cache and prediction measurements are shown separately, not added to output. Missing directions mean missing samples, not proven zero usage. These are operational measurements, not a billing ledger. Customer/model filters are not authorization boundaries.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let requestInput = AppRequests
| extend Customer = tostring(Properties["Subscription Name"]),
         Model = tostring(Properties["Response-x-aigw-model"]),
         Tokens = todouble(Properties["Response-x-aigw-quota-consumed"])
| project TimeGenerated, Customer, Model, Direction = "Input", Tokens;
let metricOutput = AppMetrics
| where Name == "Completion Tokens"
| extend Customer = tostring(Properties.Customer),
         Model = tostring(Properties.Model),
         Tokens = todouble(Sum)
| project TimeGenerated, Customer, Model, Direction = "Output", Tokens;
union requestInput, metricOutput
| where isnotempty(Customer) and isnotempty(Model) and isnotnull(Tokens) and Tokens >= 0

| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where Customer in (${customer:singlequote}) and Model in (${model:singlequote})
| summarize InputTokens = sumif(Tokens, Direction == 'Input'),
            OutputTokens = sumif(Tokens, Direction == 'Output'),
            InputRecords = countif(Direction == 'Input'),
            OutputRecords = countif(Direction == 'Output') by Customer, Model
| extend RecordedTotal = InputTokens + OutputTokens,
         Coverage = case(InputRecords == 0, 'Output samples only', OutputRecords == 0, 'Input samples only', 'Both directions observed')
| order by Customer asc, Model asc

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AppMetrics
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| extend Customer = tostring(Properties.Customer), Model = tostring(Properties.Model)
| where Customer in (${customer:singlequote}) and Model in (${model:singlequote})
| summarize MetricSum = sum(Sum), AggregatedMeasurements = sum(ItemCount) by Customer, Model, Name
| order by Customer asc, Model asc, Name asc
